Here are the instructions for a Classic Neapolitan-style pizza:

DOUGH: Dissolve 5g of fresh yeast in 280ml of warm water. Add 450g of 00 flour and 8g of sea salt. Knead by hand for 12 minutes until the dough is silky. Let it proof for 2 hours in a lightly oiled bowl.

SAUCE: Blend 1 tin of whole peeled tomatoes with 2 garlic cloves, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and dried oregano until smooth. Simmer on low for 10 minutes to concentrate the flavor.

ASSEMBLY: Stretch dough onto a lightly oiled baking tray. Spread sauce evenly with a spoon. Tear over fresh mozzarella. Scatter basil leaves and drizzle with extra virgin olive oil.

BAKING: Slide onto a hot pizza stone and bake at 240°C for 10 minutes, or until the crust is golden and the cheese has melted and has a few brown spots.

Here are the instructions for a Artisan / sourdough / pan-style pizza:

DOUGH: For a focaccia-style base, mix 400g of flour, 7g of yeast, 300ml of water, 30ml of olive oil, and 8g of salt. The dough will be wet — do not add more flour. Oil your hands and perform 3 folds every 30 minutes. Rest 1 hour.

SAUCE: Make a white base: melt 30g of butter, whisk in 30g of flour, then slowly add 300ml of warm milk. Season with salt, nutmeg, and white pepper. Cook until thick. Use as the pizza base instead of tomato.

ASSEMBLY: Stretch the sourdough into a rough oval. Spread white sauce, scatter torn mozzarella, add thinly sliced potatoes, rosemary, and a handful of rocket leaves (added after baking).

BAKING: Bake the pan pizza at 220°C for 20–25 minutes until the base is golden underneath when you lift the edge with a spatula and the top is bubbling.

Follow these steps to prepare a Classic Neapolitan-style pizza:

DOUGH: Mix 500g of tipo 00 flour with 7g of active dry yeast, 10g of salt, and 300ml of warm water. Knead for 10 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic. Cover and let rise at room temperature for 2 hours.

SAUCE: Blend 1 tin of whole peeled tomatoes with 2 garlic cloves, a drizzle of olive oil, salt, and dried oregano until smooth. Simmer on low for 10 minutes to concentrate the flavor.

ASSEMBLY: Roll the dough to 28–30cm. Apply a thin layer of sauce. Place torn buffalo mozzarella evenly across the base. Add fresh basil and a light drizzle of olive oil before baking.

BAKING: Slide onto a hot pizza stone and bake at 240°C for 10 minutes, or until the crust is golden and the cheese has melted and has a few brown spots.
